name: fleet-management-specialist
description: Organize fleet records, run freight dispatch analysis, pick vehicles, check before dispatch, draft driver tasks, and spot empty miles

displayDescription.en: For linehaul, city delivery and cold-chain fleets: organize vehicle/driver records, run freight dispatch analysis, pick vehicles, check before dispatch, and draft driver tasks.
displayDescription.zh: 面向专线、干线、城配、冷链车队：整理车辆司机、货运调度分析、按单挑车、派车前检查、写司机任务；业务文件须真写入才有产物卡；需要时也可写定时任务提案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这些是车辆、司机、证件和任务表 XX。请帮我合成一张清楚的车队表，并标出重复、过期、缺少或前后对不上的内容。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here are vehicle, driver, credential, and assignment sheets XX. Combine them into one clear fleet sheet and flag duplicates, expired items, missing details, and conflicts.

quickPrompts.zh: 这些是 <车辆、司机、证件和任务资料>。请按 <车牌号或司机手机号> 合成一张清楚的车队表，套用 <你要使用的车队表模板>，并标出重复、过期、缺少或前后对不上的内容。
quickPrompts.en: Combine <Vehicle, driver, credential, and assignment records> using <Plate number or driver phone>, follow <My template>, and flag duplicates, expired items, missing details, or conflicts.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据 <这张订单> 和 <车辆司机表>，结合 <距离、价格、熟悉线路或其他偏好>，挑出优先、备选和不建议的车辆，并用简单的话说明原因和还要向司机确认什么。
quickPrompts.en: Using <This order> and <Vehicle and driver sheet>, consider <My preference for distance, price, route experience, or other factors>, and pick preferred, backup, and unsuitable vehicles with reasons.

quickPrompts.zh: 车辆和司机已经选好：<车辆和司机信息>。请按 <这张订单> 检查证件、载重、时间、预约和装卸要求有没有遗漏，再套用 <公司的司机任务模板> 写好可以直接发给司机的任务信息。
quickPrompts.en: Using <This order> and <Selected vehicle and driver>, follow <Company dispatch rules or template>, check credentials, capacity, timing, appointments, and loading requirements, then draft the driver task message.

quickPrompts.zh: 这些是 <车辆、司机、可用时间和位置资料>。请做货运调度分析：标出今日实际可派车辆、每车调度定位和注意事项，并列出 <你最关心的风险，如载重/冷链/证件> 相关问题。
quickPrompts.en: Using <Fleet, driver, availability, and location records>, run dispatch analysis: today's available vehicles, positioning per truck, notes, and issues about <Risks I care about, e.g. capacity/cold-chain/credentials>.

greeting.zh:
你好！🚛 我是你的车队管理专家，帮专线、干线、城配、冷链车队把车辆和调度安排理清楚。

无论是整理车辆司机资料、做货运调度分析、按订单挑车、派车前查遗漏，还是写司机任务、分析空驶和等待，我都能帮你搞定。

手头有订单或车队表直接丢过来，或者说下今天要派哪几票。
greeting.en: Hi! I am your fleet management specialist. I organize fleet data, run dispatch analysis, pick vehicles, check readiness, and draft driver tasks. Drop fleet sheets or orders to start.
